_INSTRUCTIONS: Return ONE JSON object with exactly these keys. For each: {value, status, source_url, notes}. status is one of verified | verify_recommended | serve_live | agreed_stable. DEFAULT TO verify_recommended. Mark verified ONLY if source_url is an OFFICIAL source you actually opened — shgm.gov.tr (Turkish civil aviation), mevzuat.gov.tr, resmigazete.gov.tr, an airport operator's own site (istairport.com, sabihagokcen.aero), TCDD, or a named carrier's own conditions of carriage. A travel blog, OTA, comparison site or news roundup is NOT official. If you cannot source a value, return null and list the key in _open_questions. Do NOT estimate. Do NOT average two sources.
_CALIBRATION: Track record so far on this project: Turkey batch 16 returned 1/1 and 4/5 verified-with-official-source; batch 17 returned 3/3 and 3/3. Before those prompts were hardened, a Thailand panel marked 24 of 40 facts verified with only 2 citing an official source and all 22 others were downgraded. Hold the current standard.
_WHY_THIS_LOOKS_ODD: This asks for COMPONENTS and no recommendations on purpose. The articles report mechanics; the paid guide makes the calls. Do not add advice, rankings, or 'you should' framing to any notes field. In particular do NOT advise how much connection time to leave — that is the single thing this request must not contain.

transit.shy_yolcu_regulation._want: The Turkish civil aviation passenger rights regulation (SHY-Yolcu / SHY-PASSENGER) — its official name, the authority behind it, and which flights it covers.

transit.cancellation_rebook_or_refund._want: On cancellation of a domestic Turkish flight, what the carrier must offer: rebooking, rerouting, refund — and who chooses.

transit.compensation_bands._want: Compensation amounts under the Turkish regulation by distance band, and the currency they are expressed in.

transit.extraordinary_circumstances._want: The extraordinary-circumstances exception under the Turkish regulation — what it excuses and what it does not.

transit.duty_of_care_thresholds._want: Delay thresholds at which the carrier owes meals, communication and accommodation.

transit.claim_procedure._want: How a passenger files a claim under the Turkish regulation, and to which body.

transit.denied_boarding._want: What the regulation provides on denied boarding for domestic Turkish flights.

transit.ist_minimum_connection_time._want: Published minimum connection times at Istanbul Airport (IST) by connection type: international-to-international, international-to-domestic, domestic-to-international.

transit.saw_minimum_connection_time._want: Published minimum connection time at Sabiha Gokcen (SAW), if published.

transit.ist_intl_to_domestic_path._want: The physical process at IST for an international-to-domestic connection: passport control, baggage reclaim or through-check, terminal movement.

transit.transit_without_entry._want: Whether a passenger can connect at IST without clearing immigration, and the conditions.

transit.ist_terminal_scale._want: Istanbul Airport's terminal layout and the realistic walking distance between the furthest gates.

transit.ist_saw_distance_time._want: Distance and typical travel time between IST and SAW.

transit.ist_saw_transfer_options._want: The ways to travel between IST and SAW — shuttle, metro, taxi — with journey times.

transit.ist_saw_transfer_cost._want: Typical cost of each IST-SAW transfer option. Return null rather than estimating.

transit.airport_by_carrier._want: Which carriers principally operate from IST and which from SAW.

transit.through_ticket_definition._want: What legally or commercially constitutes a through-ticket versus separate tickets, and what the carrier owes in each case when a connection is missed.

transit.baggage_through_check._want: When baggage is checked through to a final destination and when it must be reclaimed and re-checked, for Turkish domestic connections.

transit.interline_agreements_turkey._want: Whether Turkish Airlines, AJet and Pegasus interline with each other, and what that means for a passenger holding legs on two of them.

transit.self_transfer_protection._want: What protection, if any, a passenger has on a self-transfer itinerary booked as separate tickets.

transit.yht_routes_times._want: Turkish high-speed rail (YHT) routes actually in service and their scheduled journey times.

transit.coach_journey_times._want: Intercity coach journey times on the main corridors used by visitors (Istanbul-Cappadocia, Istanbul-Izmir, Izmir-Antalya).

transit.rail_booking_mechanics._want: How YHT tickets are sold, how far ahead, and whether a foreign passport can book online.

transit.no_flight_corridors._want: Domestic corridors visitors use that have no scheduled flight, requiring road or rail.
